description: An import whose key has no private_key is an invalid service account.

client.body_text:
--pluxy-corpus-boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="key.json"
Content-Type: application/json

{"type":"service_account","project_id":"corpus-project","private_key_id":"corpus","client_email":"corpus-1@corpus-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com","token_uri":"{{upstream}}/token"}
--pluxy-corpus-boundary--

exceptions.reason: Different management API by design: the new management API answers an error as {error: {code, message}}, where today's core answers {error, message}; today's words are the code and the message.

error.message: invalid service account: service account missing private_key

exceptions.reason: The new core answers application/json; today's core's gin handler adds a charset to the reply.
